assumptions: This review uses only the supplied packet; no tools or commands were used.
Workers are trusted but may make accidental edits. Deliberate detachment and uncatchable termination during registration remain outside scope.
No supplied interface establishes a complete TeX dependency inventory or separate monitoring of every directory excluded by editable_files.
checks: Inspected evidence hashing, preservation, change attribution, fixed-operation validation, proposal checking and readiness derivation.
Compared supplied proposal test assertions with the evidence guarantees.
Treated the reported 141 passing tests as supporting control-plane evidence, not independently rerun tests or accounting correctness.
Confirmed that proposal readiness retains human_acceptance=pending and implementation_enabled=false.
issues: P18 does not bind every build input. In scripts/check_accounting_proposal.py, the 'all candidate sources pinned' check inventories only .tex, .bib, .sty and .cls files beneath the manuscript directory. An included image, CSV table or TeX input outside that directory can be omitted from source_files. Changing that input then leaves the checker pins unchanged, so proposal_gate can continue reporting readiness for a stale candidate. Repair: capture and validate actual build dependencies, including figures, data and external project inputs; bind their hashes into acceptance. Explicitly identify environment-managed dependencies separately. Add a regression where an omitted included figure or external input changes and readiness closes.
next_actions: Replace the suffix-based P18 dependency completeness check with a checked build dependency manifest.
Add focused regressions for changed figure/data inputs and project inputs outside the manuscript directory, then rerun verification and independent review.
Clarify or strengthen the excluded-directory monitoring and contract-reference interfaces described in residuals.
residuals: editable_files deliberately excludes configuration, caches, frozen directories and supervisor records. Consequently capture_phase_changes alone cannot enforce write scopes there. Supplied protection interfaces cover frozen/controller/state/grant bytes, but do not establish monitoring of every excluded configuration directory. A separate containment or monitoring assumption is needed for the broader claim that reviewers leave all project bytes unchanged.

P19 coverage requires contract to be merely nonempty text. It does not resolve or hash that reference. If contract is intended to name a specification file, require a checked anchor; otherwise document that it is prose and require the substantive specification through the existing evidence references.

P18 checks a PDF header, nonempty render references and a recorded successful build. These are structural checks, not proof of a successful render or inspection. The supplied synthetic tests correctly demonstrate only structural evidence; actual build/render adequacy remains an independent-review responsibility.

The packet does not include the full controller, catalog contents or master test bodies. Lifecycle, approval and repair guarantees beyond the supplied implementations remain interface assumptions for this bounded review.
Source inventory and internal phase acceptance must preserve the accepted 192-report panel without implying closure of accounting, scientific or human-acceptance gaps.
steps: Traced how checker input hashes become accepted evidence and are revalidated by proposal_gate.
Checked whether changes to inputs used to build the proposal necessarily invalidate that evidence.
summary: REVISE: proposal acceptance can remain current after an unpinned manuscript build input changes.
